articles.title: Hidden microplastic pollution in Swiss waters uncovered
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Microplastics are plastic particles smaller than 5 millimeters that originate either from manufactured products or from the breakdown of larger plastic items. They can now be found everywhere, from oceans and rivers to soils and indoor air. Because most plastics degrade very slowly, these particles can remain in the environment for decades or centuries.

articles.title: More than numbers: First global dataset shows who is immigrating
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: As countries compete for skilled workers and grapple with aging populations and labor shortages, understanding who is moving across borders is increasingly important. A new study provides the first global data set of immigration composition disaggregated simultaneously by age, sex and educational attainment, offering a new basis for tracking brain gain and brain drain and improving population projections.
